content.text: Now let me create the Recalls table in Supabase with proper RLS policies:

params.name: create_recalls_table
params.query:
-- Enable UUID extension
create extension if not exists "uuid-ossp";

-- Create storage bucket for note images
insert into storage.buckets (id, name, public)
values ('note-images', 'note-images', true)
on conflict (id) do nothing;

-- Create Recalls table
create table if not exists recalls (
  id uuid primary key default uuid_generate_v4(),
  text text,
  images text[], -- Array of image URLs
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  latitude double precision,
  longitude double precision,
  location text, -- Format: "Suburb, City"
  user_id uuid references auth.users(id) on delete cascade
);

-- Create index for faster queries
create index if not exists recalls_created_at_idx on recalls(created_at desc);
create index if not exists recalls_user_id_idx on recalls(user_id);

-- Enable Row Level Security
alter table recalls enable row level security;

-- RLS Policies for recalls table
-- Allow anyone to insert (for now, can be restricted to authenticated users)
create policy "Anyone can insert recalls"
  on recalls for insert
  with check (true);

-- Allow anyone to view all recalls (can be restricted to own records)
create policy "Anyone can view recalls"
  on recalls for select
  using (true);

-- Allow anyone to update recalls (can be restricted to own records)
create policy "Anyone can update recalls"
  on recalls for update
  using (true);

-- Allow anyone to delete recalls (can be restricted to own records)
create policy "Anyone can delete recalls"
  on recalls for delete
  using (true);

-- Storage policies for note-images bucket
create policy "Anyone can upload images"
  on storage.objects for insert
  with check (bucket_id = 'note-images');

create policy "Anyone can view images"
  on storage.objects for select
  using (bucket_id = 'note-images');

create policy "Anyone can update images"
  on storage.objects for update
  using (bucket_id = 'note-images');

create policy "Anyone can delete images"
  on storage.objects for delete
  using (bucket_id = 'note-images');
